facts.fact: The Ministry of Economy and the Instituto Nacional de Normalizacao e Qualidade (INNOQ, IP) announced on 7 May 2026 that a Certificate of Conformity under the Conformity Assessment Programme of Decree 8/2022 becomes mandatory from 1 June 2026 for listed imports (rice, fortified foods, used vehicles, tyres, construction steel); the document states no IT or data standard.

note: Body fact only; the conformity certificates are for food, vehicles and construction goods (non-IT), issued abroad via Intertek, so nothing on certification.
